relationships.subject: nociceptive activity
relationships.evidence_quote: Noxious stimuli that induce long-lasting inflammatory hypersensitivity cause nuclear export and inactivation of HDAC4.

relationships.subject: HDAC4
relationships.evidence_quote: showed that nuclear HDAC4 prevented the CFA-triggered induction of OAT1

relationships.subject: OAT1
relationships.evidence_quote: Activity of the HDAC4 target OAT1 in the spinal cord mediates mechanical hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: HDAC4
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, nuclear HDAC4 in dorsal horn neurons inhibits the development of persistent inflammatory spinal sensitization without altering basal sensitivity or acute nociception.

key_findings: Persistent inflammatory (CFA) but not acute nociception drives nuclear export of HDAC4 selectively among HDACs in dorsal horn neurons, raising histone H3 acetylation.
Nuclear-restricted HDAC4 blocks CFA induction of OAT1 (Slc22a6) and mechanical hypersensitivity; OAT1 is a pain target.
